title: Inverse image agrees with the specified restricted stalk module
statement: Let K, Ks and Omega be fields in universe u, with compatible embeddings K -> Ks -> Omega [def-pd-separable-closure], and Omega algebraically closed. Let G=Gal(Ks/K) with the Krull topology, let H be an open subgroup of G, and set L=(Ks)^H. Assume Ks is a separable closure of K and L/K is finite-dimensional. A fixed-field comparison C consists of an equivalence E from abelian etale sheaves on Spec L [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] to discrete continuous integer H-modules [def-exc-discrete-modules-category], a natural additive isomorphism j from the underlying group of E(F) to the geometric stalk F_p at the point p:Spec Omega -> Spec L induced by L -> Ks -> Omega [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and the following action compatibility. For every F, g in H, K-automorphism tau of Omega extending g on Ks, etale L-scheme X, pointed lifts x,x' of p with x'=Spec(tau) followed by x, and section z of F on X, j_F(g*j_F^{-1}(germ_x(z)))=germ_x'(z). Let T be a scheme in universe u and e:Spec L ~= T an isomorphism. For a specified discrete H-module V define P_C(V)=(e.inv)^*(E.inverse(V)) using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let R be a discrete continuous integer G-representation with underlying abelian group R.V in universe u+1. Restrict it to H with the same action. For an H-invariant additive subgroup B of R.V, write V_B for its canonical integer submodule with this restricted action; its underlying elements are exactly x in B. Let M be an abelian etale sheaf on Spec K. Let s:Spec Omega -> Spec K be induced by K -> Omega and let i:R.V ~= M_s be an additive isomorphism. Assume that for every g in G, every K-automorphism tau of Omega extending g on Ks, every etale K-scheme X, pointed lifts x,x' of s with x'=Spec(tau) followed by x, and section z of M on X, i(g*i^{-1}(germ_x(z)))=germ_x'(z). Define q:T->Spec K by e.inv followed by Spec(K->L). Then q^*M is isomorphic to P_C(R restricted to H). No prime, subgroup chain, or quotient is part of this assertion.

source.place: Tags 04JQ (abelian stalk equivalence), 03QT and 03QW (canonical germ action); blueprint lem-sc-affine-generic-second, proof paragraphs 1--2; fixed-field correspondence in Tag 0BML where applicable. Read the named Stacks pages online during repair.

proof.text: Apply the fixed-field pullback comparison to obtain an isomorphism from the pullback of M along Spec(Ks^H) -> Spec K to C.inverse applied to the restricted representation. This is the represented-germ and equivariance argument packaged in the lower theorem.

Let f=e.inv and g=Spec(K -> Ks^H). The canonical upper-star composition isomorphism identifies upperStar (f ≫ g) M with upperStar f (upperStar g M). Map the lower isomorphism along upperStar f and compose with this canonical isomorphism to obtain the displayed comparison with primaryAssociatedSheaf.

theorem primary_inverseImage_restriction
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (R : Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, u + 1} ℤ (Gal(Ks/K)))
    (i : AddCommGrpCat.of R.obj.V ≅
      ((pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M)
    (haction : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (_hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x x' : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X)
      (_hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
      (z : M.obj.obj (op X)),
      i.hom (R.obj.ρ g (i.inv ((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber X x M.obj z))) =
      (pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber
        X x' M.obj z)
    (H : OpenSubgroup (Gal(Ks/K)))
    [FiniteDimensional K (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup)]
    (C : PrimaryFixedFieldEquivalence K Ks H)
    (hC : PrimaryFixedFieldComparison K Ks H Ω C)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (e : Spec (.of (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup)) ≅ T) :
    Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (e.inv ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap K (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup))))).obj M ≅
      primaryAssociatedSheaf K Ks H Ω C T e (primaryRestrictedModule K Ks H R))
